relations.subject: András Róna-Tas
relations.role: professor of Altaic Studies and Early Hungarian History
relations.evidence: From 1968 to 2002, Róna-Tas was professor of Altaic Studies and Early Hungarian History at József Attila University in Szeged, where he is now a distinguished professor emeritus.

relations.subject: András Róna-Tas
